gripOrHq.rulesText: [Subroutine] Runner cannot break any subroutines of the next piece of ice encountered during the run, and cannot jack out until after that encounter.

gripOrHq.title: Vacuum Link
gripOrHq.rulesText: [Subroutine] Roll a die. If you roll a 1, 2, or 3, Runner resumes the run from that many pieces of rezzed ice back, or jacks out. If there are not that many pieces of ice, Runner returns to the first piece of ice.

heapOrArchives.rulesText: Rezzing ACME S&L costs 1 agenda point, in addition to the normal cost. When you rez ACME S&L, gain [12] and trash ACME S&L. For the remainder of the game, pay [1] at the end of each of your turns, or lose the game. You can remove this effect, and score 1 agenda point, by taking an action to pay [12].

discardCards.title: R&D Mole
discardCards.rulesText: [4], [T]: Access two additional cards from R&D. Use this ability only when accessing cards from R&D. Hidden resources are installed face down, but are put into the trash face up.

discardCards.title: Security Code WORM Chip
discardCards.rulesText: Play only if you made a successful run on HQ this turn. Trash a piece of unrezzed ice.

discardCards.title: Inside Job
discardCards.rulesText: Make a run. You automatically pass the first piece of ice you encounter during that run.

discardCards.title: Social Engineering
discardCards.rulesText: Hide at least 2 from your pool in your hand; the Corp then guesses how many bits you hid. If the Corp guesses correctly, lose that many bits. Otherwise, choose a data fort and a piece of ice on that fort. Then make a run on that fort, during which you automatically pass that piece of ice.

discardCards.title: Viral Pipeline
discardCards.rulesText: After each successful run on Archives, HQ, or R&D, put a Socket counter in that data fort. Socket counter from Archives, Socket counter from HQ, and Socket counter from R&D: Give the Corp a Pipe counter. Each Pipe counter causes the Corp to forgo an action at the start of each of its turns. The Corp may remove all Virus counters at any time, but must then forgo its next three actions.

scoreArea.title: Corporate Coup
scoreArea.rulesText:
Put [15] from the bank on Corporate Coup when you score it.
A: Take [3] from Corporate Coup, if it has any bits.

scoreArea.title: Security Net Optimization
scoreArea.rulesText: Choose a fort when scored. Ice installed on that fort gets +1 strength.

rig.title: Krash
rig.rulesText:
2 credits: Break ice subroutine.
2 credits: +1 strength.

rig.title: Armageddon
rig.rulesText: After each successful run on R&D, you may choose to give the Corp a Doom counter instead of accessing cards from R&D. Each Doom counter forces the Corp to roll a die whenever it installs a card. On a 6, the card is trashed after it is installed, and the Corp removes a Doom counter. The Corp may remove all Virus counters at any time, but must then forgo its next three actions.

rig.title: The Short Circuit
rig.rulesText: A, [1]: Search your stack for a program. Show that program to the Corp, and then bring it into your hand. Reshuffle your stack afterwards.
